string-array.name: import_links_steps
string-array.item: In the app your accounts are in, look for an export as plain text, URI list or otpauth links. Most apps keep it under Settings, Backup or Export.
Save the file it makes. It holds one link per line, each starting with otpauth://.
Choose that file here. Lines that aren\'t links are ignored.

resources.string: The links hold your secrets in the clear. Delete the file once the import is done.
